title: PWM Generator
constraints: An internal 8-bit counter `cnt` is cleared by the synchronous reset and increments (wrapping 255 → 0) on every other rising edge.
`pwm_out = (cnt < duty)`, a combinational compare against the current `duty` input.
The period is 256 clock cycles: `duty = 0` is always low, `duty = 255` is high for 255 of every 256 cycles.
hints: You need exactly one register: the 8-bit counter.
Let the counter wrap naturally by using an 8-bit width.
Keep the compare outside the clocked block, since `pwm_out` reacts to `duty` immediately.

examples.title: 25 % duty
examples.expected: pwm_out high for 64 cycles, low for 192, repeating

examples.title: duty change
examples.input: duty switches from 200 to 10 in mid-period
examples.expected: pwm_out follows the new compare right away
